ecarts: Card variant gold-soft resolves to bg-violet-soft, identical to violet-soft.
ProgressBar tone gold resolves to bg-violet, identical to tone violet.
globals.css says gold is wordmark-only, but EmptyState DefaultMark fills a circle with var(--color-gold).
Pill hardcodes 11 rgba() literals; tone violet uses rgba(107,78,168) which is not --color-violet (134,91,166).
MetricTile and QueryError use a literal rounded-[12px], between radius-sm (10) and radius-md (14).
Input's comment says gold focus ring; the ring is violet.
No spacing token layer: Tailwind's default 4px scale is inherited; /styleguide renders no spacing specimen.
